$comment: Where each ai_tooling/instructions file applies, for agents that get it as a rule file
scoped by globs (Copilot: *.instructions.md + applyTo; Cursor: *.mdc + globs; Antigravity:
trigger: model_decision with the globs in the description, for a file whose own frontmatter
says trigger: glob or has no trigger).
Kept here, not in the files, because the update-*.ps1 installers may overwrite those.
Globs are relative to the repository root. allApps: every app folder with its own
AGENTS.md, so a new app is covered without editing this file.
A file in ai_tooling/instructions/ without an entry is published as on-demand only, with
a warning; verify-agent-setup.ps1 fails on it.

coding-principles.md.description: Coding principles for every change to app code
